extra.reason: Scaffold: Cargo crate, herdr-plugin.toml, install.sh, GitHub release workflow, git-cliff, README, example config.
config.toml parse/validate + seed from example; unit tests.
Live directory suggestions, Tab accept, Enter commits existing dir.
ratatui wizard: dir → name → tiled cards → cancel/save.
workspace create + tab/pane split/rename/run from profile; fake-runner tests.
Plugin implemented: popup form + layout profiles + prebuilt-binary install path.
Profiles now load from nested config.yaml with YAML | multiline commands. Seed, tests, live test profile updated.
open returns success immediately when a popup is already open and retries in a detached wait-open process until the caller (telescope) closes.
ctrl+j/k moves dir suggestions; inner New workspace frame removed so Herdr popup chrome is the only border; form colors follow herdr theme.name + theme.custom (gruvbox + sidebar_bg).
Directory/Name are bordered inputs; suggestions hide after dir commit; popup 70%x42% with fixed-height compact profile cards.
Panes can declare agent+kind+args; apply uses herdr agent start so Herdr tracks named agents.
Added test tab with QA (codex gpt-5.6-luna, medium) to team profile fixture and live config.yaml
